description: This file contains a utility function 'shapeAgentGroupedSeries' that processes raw cost records into a format suitable for visualization with Recharts. It groups data by agent and a secondary dimension ('environment' or 'cost_category'), filling in missing categories with zero to ensure consistent grouped datasets for charting.

methods.name: shapeAgentGroupedSeries(records, groupBy = "environment", options)
methods.description: Transforms an array of cost records into a grouped dataset suitable for visualization, grouping by agents and a secondary dimension, with zero-filled categories for consistency.
